tokens.name: maroon
tokens.usage: Temple Maroon — the primary brand colour. Headings, primary buttons, active navigation, links. 10.2:1 on ivory. Identical in both themes (brand constant).

tokens.name: maroon-deep
tokens.usage: Pressed / hover state of maroon fills. Ivory text on it is 12.5:1.

tokens.name: burgundy
tokens.usage: Deep Burgundy — dark sections: hero at dusk, heritage chapters, footer. Pair with ivory text (14.3:1) or gold-soft (8.9:1).

tokens.name: gold
tokens.usage: Antique Gold — decorative ONLY: hairline rules, ornament strokes, icon outlines, small diamonds. 2.9:1 on ivory, so never body text on light grounds. On burgundy it reads 4.9:1 and may carry 18px+ labels.

tokens.name: gold-soft
tokens.usage: Gold for TEXT on burgundy and maroon grounds: eyebrows, dates, numerals in dark sections (8.9:1 on burgundy).

tokens.name: ivory
tokens.usage: Warm Ivory — the literal page colour. Also the text colour on maroon and burgundy.

tokens.name: cream
tokens.usage: Temple Cream — the literal secondary ground for alternating sections and form panels.

tokens.name: charcoal
tokens.usage: Charcoal — the literal primary text colour.

tokens.name: muted-brown
tokens.usage: Muted Brown as specified in the brief. 5.1:1 on ivory but only 4.4:1 on cream — for secondary text on cream use ink-muted instead.

tokens.name: saffron
tokens.usage: Dhaja saffron — the temple flag. Tiny accents only: the live/‘નવું’ dot, the flag glyph, one word of emphasis per page at most. 5.1:1 on ivory.

tokens.name: logo-red
tokens.usage: Exact ink of the supplied logo artwork. Reserved for the logo and mark; never for UI, text or buttons.

tokens.name: whatsapp
tokens.usage: WhatsApp's own green — only inside the WhatsApp glyph disc. Never as a text colour or button fill.

tokens.name: whatsapp-deep
tokens.usage: Fill of the ‘WhatsApp સમુદાયમાં જોડાઓ’ button. White text on it is 6.6:1.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background. Ivory by day; near-black sanctum by night.

tokens.name: surface-alt
tokens.usage: Alternating section ground and form panels.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, accordions, form inputs, header after scroll.

tokens.name: surface-inverse
tokens.usage: Dark storytelling sections inside a light page (hero at dusk, heritage, footer).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body text on surface, surface-alt and surface-raised (13.9:1 day, 16.6:1 night).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text — captions, meta, dates — on surface, surface-alt and surface-raised (≥4.9:1 in both themes).

tokens.name: ink-inverse
tokens.usage: Text on surface-inverse, maroon and burgundy.

tokens.name: ink-inverse-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on surface-inverse (≥8:1).

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Interactive colour: primary button fill, links, active nav, selected chips. Maroon by day, gold-soft by night.

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: Hover/pressed accent.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an accent fill (10.2:1 day, 10.6:1 night).

tokens.name: heading
tokens.usage: Display and section headings on surface and surface-alt.

tokens.name: gold-ink
tokens.usage: Gold that may be READ: eyebrows, small ornament labels, numerals on light grounds (5.2:1 on ivory, 4.5:1 on cream).

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers and card borders — decorative, not a control boundary.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Input and checkbox borders — control boundaries (3.1:1 on their grounds).

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: The focus ring: 2px solid, 3px offset, on every interactive element. ≥4.3:1 on ivory, ≥6:1 on maroon; ≥11:1 at night.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Form success (registration received). Always with a check icon and words — never colour alone.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Form errors. Always with an alert icon and a Gujarati sentence explaining the fix.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Overlay behind the mobile menu and the gallery lightbox.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: One per page: the hero headline. Fluid clamp(44px, 7vw, 88px).

styles.name: display-l
styles.usage: Inner page heroes and the closing devotional line. clamp(38px, 5.5vw, 64px).

styles.name: heading-l
styles.usage: Sub-sections, chapter titles in the history book. clamp(26px, 3vw, 32px).

styles.name: numeral
styles.usage: Gujarati numerals for dates and countdown units.

styles.name: heading-m
styles.usage: Card titles, event names, FAQ questions.

styles.name: body-l
styles.sample: આસ્થા, પરંપરા અને ભવ્ય સ્થાપત્યનું મિલન
styles.usage: Lead paragraphs under a section heading. Max 60ch.

styles.name: body-m
styles.sample: સેવા માટે નોંધણી કરો અને મહોત્સવમાં જોડાઓ.
styles.usage: Default body copy. Max 68ch. Gujarati needs the tall 1.75 leading for matras.

styles.name: body-s
styles.usage: Card descriptions, form help text, footer links.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: The line above a section heading, in gold-ink (gold-soft on dark).

styles.name: poster-display
styles.usage: Printed posters and WhatsApp/Instagram announcement graphics only — never on the website, which speaks in the display serif.

tokens.name: space-xs
tokens.usage: Icon-to-text gaps, hairline offsets.

tokens.name: space-sm
tokens.usage: Tight stacks: eyebrow→heading, chip gaps.

tokens.name: space-md
tokens.usage: Mobile side gutter; paragraph gaps; input padding.

tokens.name: space-lg
tokens.usage: Card padding; grid gaps on mobile.

tokens.name: space-xl
tokens.usage: Card grid gaps on desktop; heading→content.

tokens.name: space-2xl
tokens.usage: Desktop side gutter; section padding on mobile.

tokens.name: space-3xl
tokens.usage: Section padding on tablet.

tokens.name: space-4xl
tokens.usage: Section padding on desktop — the generous breathing room between chapters.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs, chips, small cards, image thumbnails.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Cards, accordions, form panels.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Large feature cards, the WhatsApp community panel.

tokens.name: radius-arch
tokens.usage: The temple arch: apply to the TOP corners only (border-radius: var(--radius-arch) var(--radius-arch) var(--radius-sm) var(--radius-sm)) on a portrait frame — Mata darshan, heritage portraits, the hero medallion.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons and filter chips.

tokens.name: shadow-soft
tokens.usage: Resting cards, the scrolled header.

tokens.name: shadow-medium
tokens.usage: Hovered cards, the photo-upload drop zone while dragging, dialogs.

tokens.name: motion-fast
tokens.usage: Hover colour, button arrow nudge, focus ring.

tokens.name: motion-normal
tokens.usage: Accordion open, header compaction, card lift.

tokens.name: motion-slow
tokens.usage: Section reveal (fade + 24px rise), masked image reveal.

tokens.name: motion-ambient
tokens.usage: The slowest drift: hero image scale 1→1.04, mandala rotation. Disabled under prefers-reduced-motion.

tokens.name: ease-temple
tokens.usage: The one easing curve — a long, calm settle. Used by every transition.

tokens.name: content-max
tokens.usage: Max width of the content column (12-col grid).

tokens.name: text-max
tokens.usage: Max width of running Gujarati prose.

tokens.name: header-height
tokens.usage: Header over the hero.

tokens.name: header-height-compact
tokens.usage: Header after scrolling.
